## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:记录页字段区(右侧预览、手机「详情」、整页)里,可以编辑的空字段从「—」变成浅色的「设置某某」,点一下就进编辑;有值的可编辑字段,鼠标移上去右边也出现复制图标,点它只复制,不进编辑。
- 为什么做:卡 #36292,是记录页重做专题 #35590 里你说「立」的第 4 条。单击进编辑、可点文字照常打开,这两项 #36234 已经做了;本 PR 补上剩下的两项。
- 出错会怎样:最多是空字段的字或复制图标显示不对,保存的数据不受影响,可以整体撤回。自己搭的记录页和其它详情视图不变。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:L1 ACCEPT。`Clause-②: yes (widening)` 只新增一个 i18n 键,声明面的 L2 由席位在跑。非受管,由记录区落地。落地前请记录区把卡验收要的截图补进正文,见文末落地条款。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36385` CLEAN,13 项都没有标记;draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36292`。卡的 5 条逐条对上:正文里的表格写明第 1、2a、4 条在 main b3bcfefc 上已由 #36234 交付,2b 和 3 由本 PR 补齐;第 5 条成立,因为三处用的是同一个 frameless 字段面(`useDefaultRecordPage()`,DetailSection.tsx:264;手机分组行只在非 frameless 时走,:882)。所以用 `Fixes` 是对的。改动 14 个文件 +204 −7;`check-governed-merges` 判定 NOT governed,211 行。
- 实现读法:占位分支的条件是 `isEmpty && frameless && canInlineEditField`。`canInlineEditField` 已经包含只读、计算字段、系统字段、排除内联编辑、无写权限、无 `onEnterInlineEdit` 这几种情况,所以卡上要求「只读或无权限仍显示 —」的地方都保持原样。按钮块从三元式拆成两个兄弟元素:非 frameless 面上,可编辑的仍只有铅笔,只读的仍只有复制,和以前一样;frameless 面上,可编辑的同时有铅笔和复制。`canCopy = hasCellValue(value)`(:841),所以空值不出复制图标。`fieldLabelText` 只是挪到前面声明,值没变。区里答 A(自己搭的记录页不动,范围按裁决 7066516044),本 PR 照做。
- i18n:`detail.setField` 在 11 个语言包里都有,我逐个读过,译文都带 `{{field}}`,语序符合各自语言(ja「を設定」、de「festlegen」在后、ru 用书名号)。
- changeset 逐句核:相符。
- 测试证据:在现有字段列表测试里新增两个 describe,包括占位和点击进编辑、5 条对照(有值、只读、不可内联编辑、无写权限且用真实 `MePermissionsProvider`、非字段面),zh-CN 用真实 `I18nProvider` 显示「设置备注」,另有复制按钮的钉和两条对照。两处消融:关掉占位分支,4 条变红;把复制按钮收回到只读行,1 条变红;恢复后按 blob 证明一致。这些用例我没有在本地重跑,读的是报告和 CI。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `2c35661f`:45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。
- 接受的偏差:卡验收要的「空字段和编辑中的截图」没有做,正文如实写成 NOT MEASURED,理由是这台机器上没有可跑的 Console。行为已由 jsdom 钉住,所以我不因此 REWORK,改成落地条件。
- 范围外去向:无。
- 落地条款:非受管,211 行 ≤ 3000;等席位的 L2 PASS,以及记录区把截图补进 PR 正文(改正文不动 head,不用重审),之后由记录区 ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2c35661f855033a8c5d950b06e114b56298f0b62`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset; no published schema and no governed path in the 14-path diff, merge base `b3bcfefcb8`). Inputs read: card #36292 body and all four comments (triage 7074940287, claim 7075947584, os-dev-report 7076947391, claim amendment 7076962791), the linked ruling 7066516044 on #36147, the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on this head: every check-run concluded success or skipped (conditional legs), none failed or is pending; `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI` (16/16), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI` and `Lint & Repo Gates` all success.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@object-ui/i18n`: one new key, `detail.setField`, added to each of the eleven packs the package ships (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; the locales directory holds no twelfth pack), each beside `detail.clickToEdit` in the `detail` group, each interpolating `{{field}}`, the param the one caller passes. Public-surface change: the exported `TranslationKeys` type (`typeof en`) gains one member. Additive only; no key removed, renamed or re-meant. Named right: a widening.
2. `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `DetailSection`: no prop, export or schema key added or removed; no accept-set change. The rendering change is behind `frameless` (`useDefaultRecordPage() && !isPrintPage`) at both points: (a) an empty value with `canInlineEditField` reads `t('detail.setField', { field })` instead of the shared `EmptyValue` dash; (b) the copy button is now drawn beside the keyboard-only pencil on an editable frameless row (`copyOffered && (!canInlineEditField || frameless)`). `copyOffered` still carries `!isMaskedField`, and the button still carries `pointer-coarse:hidden`, so the ruling 7066516044 invariants (masked and ungranted fields not copyable, no copy icon on phone) hold. The button is a sibling of the value element, outside its click handler, so a copy does not enter edit (pinned). `fieldLabelText` is hoisted above `displayValue`, not changed. Named right: no contract change in this package beyond what it renders.
3. Accept-set at the metadata layer: none. Nothing a metadata author writes is added, refused or re-meant; the face is the default page's, not an authorable key (ADR-0085, as the `DefaultRecordPageContext` docblock states). `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right: `@object-ui/i18n` is published and its pack shape widens by one key; nothing narrows, so no `(narrowing)` arm, no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition are owed. The claim's original `no (expected)` was amended to `yes (widening)` on the card (7076962791) from the dev's measurement, and the PR body and the changeset both carry the amended line, line-initial.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right (see ① 3), on the PR body and the changeset.
- Level: AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. The changeset `.changeset/36292-record-field-set-placeholder.md` names exactly the two packages the diff moves, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`, both `patch`. Matches. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question (os-dev-report 7076947391): should items 1 to 3 reach authored record pages and other `DetailView` hosts? The area answered A (7076962791): authored pages keep the double-click, the pencil and the dash, inside ruling 7066516044 scope. The diff stays inside A. Both new branches are gated on `frameless`, which is true only under `DefaultRecordPageContext`, and that context is provided only (i) by `RecordPageColumns`, which `RecordDetailView` builds only when `pageColumnsEligible` (`!assignedPage && !namedPageBlocked`), and (ii) around the fallback tab strip with the value `!assignedPage && !namedPageBlocked`. An authored page, the drawer and overlay panel, a dashboard and a standalone `DetailView` read the default `false` and keep their faces. The PR pins the control (off the field face an empty editable value keeps the dash, and an editable row keeps the pencil alone with no copy button). Answered, no escalation; option B would widen a maintainer-scoped ruling and is correctly not built.
- Dev deviations (4): (1) PR-body line order and (2) by-symbol citations are process items, not contract. (3) Screenshots the card's acceptance asks for are NOT MEASURED; that belongs to L1 and acceptance, not to this face, and is noted here only so it is not lost. (4) The Clause-② amendment is checked above and holds.
- Card 没有核对的 items (approval-locked records; tap versus scroll on a phone): not moved by this diff. A locked record is not inline-editable, so its empty fields keep the dash; the single tap itself shipped in #36234.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): the diff reads no data, adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to push down; no finding.
- Findings, graded:
  - nit: the changeset headline says `feat(console)` while the two packages it ships are `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`; cosmetic, the bullets are accurate.
  - nit: the placeholder span carries no `aria-label`, so a screen reader hears the visible text 「设置备注」 and no longer the dash's "No value" name on an editable empty row. The visible text is arguably the clearer name; no contract effect.
  - No must-fix, no should-fix.
